verdict.rationale: AMD explicitly documents AM5 socket multi-generation support commitment ('the only processor manufacturer committed to multi-year socket support... start with what fits your build today and upgrade to next-gen performance tomorrow'), directly matching the power-user's platform-upgrade story. Independent reviews corroborate the CPU's compatibility and performance on the existing platform, though none explicitly verify AMD's multi-gen socket claim independently. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of the socket longevity commitment beyond AMD's own marketing, and explicit naming of AM5 socket generations supported.
